Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.inbound

Interface GenerateMarketIntelligenceUseCase

All Known Implementing Classes:
MarketIntelligenceService
public interface GenerateMarketIntelligenceUseCase
Inbound port — drive generation of a Healthcare AI market intelligence report.

The implementation lives in domain.service and orchestrates calls to SearchPromptPort (to load the configured prompt) and AiReportPort (to call the AI model and receive the HTML report back).

This port is intentionally narrow — it takes no parameters because the prompt and AI configuration are fully managed through search_prompts (engine key MARKET_INTELLIGENCE) and application.yml. Callers simply invoke generate() and receive a complete, dated report.
